title: Torch Inference
description: A Rust/actix-web multimodal model server: TTS, STT, vision, and LLM chat, all behind a shared batching/pooling/resilience core.

adaptive-request-batching.title: Adaptive Request Batching
adaptive-request-batching.description: Groups concurrent requests into GPU-efficient batches with a queue-depth-adaptive timeout.

in-flight-request-coalescing.title: In-Flight Request Coalescing
in-flight-request-coalescing.description: Deduplicates identical concurrent requests so redundant work isn't repeated while one is already in progress.

model-tensor-pooling.title: Model & Tensor Pooling
model-tensor-pooling.description: Pools loaded models and pre-allocated tensors to avoid reload/allocation overhead per request.

dynamic-model-registry.title: Dynamic Model Registry
dynamic-model-registry.description: Downloads, registers, and manages ONNX/PyTorch model artifacts on demand, including auto-download on first server start.

text-to-speech-synthesis.title: Text-to-Speech Synthesis
text-to-speech-synthesis.description: Serves speech synthesis across six interchangeable engines (Kokoro-ONNX primary, plus Bark/XTTS/StyleTTS2/Piper/VITS).

speech-to-text-transcription.title: Speech-to-Text Transcription
speech-to-text-transcription.description: Transcribes audio via a Whisper ONNX encoder/decoder pipeline.

image-classification-detection.title: Image Classification & Detection
image-classification-detection.description: Runs ONNX image classification (EfficientNet-Lite4) and YOLOv8 object detection with NMS.

llm-chat-completion.title: LLM Chat Completion
llm-chat-completion.description: Proxies to a separate microservice offering an OpenAI-compatible streaming chat endpoint over an HRM-Text engine or SmolVLM-256M vision model.

agentic-tool-use-layer.title: Agentic Tool-Use Layer
agentic-tool-use-layer.description: A planner/executor loop lets the LLM call tools (HTTP fetch, TTS, STT, classify, detect, vision, reflection) — the newest, least-mature subsystem in the repo.

circuit-breakers-backpressure.title: Circuit Breakers & Backpressure
circuit-breakers-backpressure.description: Per-model circuit breakers, bulkheads, and token-bucket rate limiting protect backend model calls.

request-security-auth.title: Request Security & Auth
request-security-auth.description: Input sanitization/validation, auth middleware, and security middleware guard the API surface.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Structured logging, Prometheus metrics, and correlation-ID middleware instrument every request.

react-dashboard-consolidated-panels.title: React Dashboard & Consolidated Panels
react-dashboard-consolidated-panels.description: A React frontend with dashboard, chat, TTS, STT, classify, and detect views, log viewing, and a health indicator wired to the backend.

frontend-resource-hygiene.title: Frontend Resource Hygiene
frontend-resource-hygiene.description: Blob URLs (image previews, chat TTS audio) are properly revoked and SSE chat streams stop updating after tab-switch unmount.
